lines: Yeh daulat bhi le lo, yeh shohrat bhi le lo
couplets.en: Take this wealth, take this fame too.

lines: Bhale chheen lo mujhse meri jawaani
couplets.en: Take even my youth away from me.

lines: Yeh daulat bhi le lo, yeh shohrat bhi le lo, bhale chheen lo mujhse meri jawaani
Magar mujhko lauta do bachpan ka saawan, woh kaghaz ki kashti, woh baarish ka paani
couplets.en: Take my wealth, my fame, even my youth, but give me back the monsoon of my childhood, that paper boat, that rainwater.

lines: Woh kaghaz ki kashti, woh baarish ka paani
couplets.en: Give me back that paper boat, that rainwater.

lines: Mohalle ki sab se puraani nishaani
couplets.en: I remember the oldest familiar sight in the neighborhood.

lines: Mohalle ki sab se puraani nishaani
Woh budhiya jise bachche kehte the naani
couplets.en: The oldest familiar sight in the neighborhood was the old woman the children called Grandma.

lines: Woh naani ki baaton mein pariyon ka dera
Woh chehre ki jhurriyon mein sadiyon ka phera
couplets.en: Fairies dwelt in Grandma's stories, and centuries passed through the lines of her face.

lines: Bhulaaye nahin bhool sakta hai koi
Woh chhoti si raatein, woh lambi kahaani
couplets.en: However hard you try, you cannot forget those short nights and that long story.

lines: Kadi dhoop mein apne ghar se nikalna
couplets.en: I remember stepping out of the house into the fierce sun.

lines: Kadi dhoop mein apne ghar se nikalna, woh chidiya, woh bulbul, woh titli pakadna
Woh gudiya ki shaadi pe ladna-jhagadna, woh jhoolon se girna, woh gir ke sambhalna, woh peetal ke chhallon ke pyaare se tohfe
couplets.en: I remember going out in the fierce sun to catch birds and butterflies, squabbling over a doll's wedding, falling off swings and getting up again, and those little brass rings we gave as gifts.

lines: Woh peetal ke chhallon ke pyaare se tohfe
Woh tooti huin choodiyon ki nishaani
couplets.en: I remember those little brass rings we gave as gifts and the broken bangles we kept as keepsakes.

lines: Woh tooti huin choodiyon ki nishaani
Kabhi ret ke oonche teelon pe jaana
couplets.en: Sometimes we would climb the high sand dunes.

lines: Woh khwaabon-khilaunon ki jaageer apni
couplets.en: We had a kingdom of dreams and toys all our own.

lines: Na duniya ka gham tha, na rishton ke bandhan
Badi khoobsurat thi woh zindagaani
couplets.en: Life was beautiful then, free of the world's sorrows and the ties that bind.

lines: Badi khoobsurat thi woh zindagaani
Yeh daulat bhi le lo, yeh shohrat bhi le lo
Bhale chheen lo mujhse meri jawaani
couplets.en: Take this wealth, take this fame, take even my youth away from me.

lines: Magar mujhko lauta do bachpan ka saawan
Woh kaghaz ki kashti, woh baarish ka paani
couplets.en: But give me back the monsoon of my childhood, that paper boat, that rainwater.

couplets.en: Give me back that paper boat, that rainwater.
